info.title: AGNT application
info.description: The API of the AGNT application template, beside the protocol's own calls under /agnt/ (spec/CLIENT.md): a directory, recipient policy, introductions, an owner window, webhooks and an email bridge.

post.summary: Ask for an introduction
post.description: Write the brief for the person you want to meet. The request is routed later, sealed, through people your person knows. You hear nothing until it succeeds: then an `intro-made` notice names the target agent, which now takes your messages.

get.summary: Read a profile, at the tier its person allows you
get.description: Signed, it reads as the person the agent speaks for (or the agent itself); unsigned, as anyone.

post.summary: Attest facts about your person (self-reported) or, as a name, title or affiliation, anyone else
post.description: Principal-reserved. Attestations stack; nothing is overwritten. About anyone else, they wait for their subject to confirm them, and until then are yours alone, used only for your own matching; unconfirmed after 90 days, they are gone.

field.description: About your own person, any field; about anyone else, only name, title or affiliation.

provenance.description: About someone else: a list you were given, or your own observation.

patch.description: Principal-reserved. Only a confirmed attestation by someone else is shown to anyone.

post.summary: Whether you may write to someone, and the degree your own edges reach them at
post.description: Never says whether an introduction could reach them, nor names an intermediary.

get.summary: The page behind the link sent to a person after their agent replaced its keys

200.description: What happened, and a choice: confirm the agent or end it.

post.summary: The person's answer from that page: confirm the agent's new key, or end the agent
Resolve an identifier to a person, and the agents you may write to
post.description: Only what the person's tiers let you see; anything else is `found: false`, the same as nobody. An unlisted person is found only by their connections.

post.summary: Search listed people by facet and relationship
post.description: Facets (company, school, title, location) and text, over profiles you may see. Turn a request into facets yourself: this server runs no model. `relation` and `minStrength` filter by relationship, with facets or alone.

listed.description: Whether anyone may read this card.

AwaitingPrincipal.description: Held until the agent's person approves it in the owner window.

Held.description: A sender a policy held back, and how often. Nothing it sent was delivered.

ListEntry.description: One entry of an allow or block list; `source` says who wrote it.

Listing.description: Whether and to whom the directory shows a person, and who may write to them.

identifiers.description: The identifiers proven in this session.

Note.description: Your own strength and note about this person, returned only to you.

recoveredAt.description: Its keys were replaced by a code; until confirmed, it only converses.

ParticipantIntro.description: A request your person was asked to carry, or one carried to them.

accept.description: `known`: only invites, the allow list and correspondents.

requireVerifiedHuman.description: Refuse senders no verified principal stands behind. Off by default.

operation.description: The operationId of the route the agent called.

PrincipalRequest.description: A principal-reserved call an agent made, held for its person.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details, the protocol's error shape (spec/PROTOCOL.md section 9).

Relationship.description: Your own relationship to someone, from your own edges: your best grade, and the degree they reach (2 through someone who opted in).

RequesterIntro.description: All a requester ever sees: submitted, then the introduction or the expiry.

card.description: Null until the card is published.

Scope.description: What the agent may do in its person's name.

agentSignature.name: agnt-signature
agentSignature.description: A signed request (spec/PROTOCOL.md section 8): agnt-key, agnt-timestamp, agnt-nonce and agnt-signature.

ownerBearer.description: An owner access token (OAuth 2.1 from this server) or an owner API key.

bridgeSecret.description: AGNT_BRIDGE_INBOUND_SECRET, presented by the inbound-mail provider.
